articles.image_title: Nachrichtenpodcast: Germany Opens New Drone Security Center HECKLINGEN, GERMANY - AUGUST 18: (From L to R) Chairwoman of the German Aerospace Center (DLR) Anke Kaysser-Pyzalla; Technology, Applied Research And Space Minister Dorothee Baer, Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt and Saxony-Anhalt Premier Sven Schulze look at mockups of threatening drones at the opening of the new DLR drone security center at Cochstedt airport on August 18, 2026 in Hecklingen, Germany. The center, which will work together with law enforcement, is tasked with developing new technologies towards drone security. Germany experiences frequent incidents of disruptions due to drones, including the recent failed attack by an explosive-laden drone on a Ukrainian cargo plane stationed at Leipzig Airport.
